assets.image_policy: Only Firecracker consumes Ubuntu; pVisor uses --rootfs host and its own embedded kernel
assets.sha_verification: Official HTTPS SHA256SUMS; GPG signature not verified
assets.provisioning: QEMU KVM, user networking, native Ubuntu apt tools plus installed Rust/Claude/Codex; outside timings
assets.provisioning_shape: Untimed QEMU: 1 vCPU host,-rdseed,-rdrand; measured Firecracker VMs: 2 vCPU defaults
assets.firecracker_transport: Default virtio MMIO, no PCI; rd.driver.pre=virtio_mmio; reboot=t
assets.temporary_files: Private /work/_tmp for all complete task tools; host workload uses its own workspace/_tmp
assets.prepared_template_update: Only benchmark workload/environment updated offline after clean shutdown; kernel and Ubuntu services unchanged
